title: Token-bucket rate limiter
hints: Store the clock: self._now = now. Never import time. In __init__ set self._tokens = float(capacity) and self._last = now().
Write one private method _refill() implementing the rule from the description (elapsed, min with capacity, update _last) and call it at the top of allow, available and seconds_until.

allow: after _refill, `if self._tokens >= cost: self._tokens -= cost; return True` else return False. seconds_until: 0.0 if enough, else (cost - self._tokens) / self.rate. Check cost > capacity before anything else.
